info.title: 3rd Party LIS API
info.description:
The **Beta version** of this API is a pre-release version made available for external testing and feedback. It may contain new features and functionality that are still under development. While the API is largely functional, it is not guaranteed to be fully stable, and breaking changes may occur as we refine the product based on user feedback.

We encourage developers to use the Beta version for testing purposes but advise caution when integrating it into production systems. Feedback from users during the Beta phase will help improve the API before the final, stable release.

servers.description: api url details shared upon api access approval

post.summary: Creates a new movement record (sync or async).
post.description: Creates a new movement in the system using the details provided in the request body. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the movement is created immediately and the created resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the creation status.

200.description: OK - Successful operation with identifier in response body.

get.description:
Retrieves one or more movement records from the system based on the supplied query parameters. The response returns matching records that meet the filtering criteria. If no filters are provided, the endpoint returns records according to the default retrieval rules.
The movement `state` value returned in each record is context-sensitive and depends on the role of the requesting user. The state may differ depending on whether the viewer is the Originator or the Counterparty of the movement.

parameters.name: siteIdentifier
parameters.description: The end-point returns movements where departure/arrival is this site.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific movement by movement number.
get.description:
Retrieves the details of a single movement using its unique movementNumber. If the specified movement exists, the full resource is returned. If the movement does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.
The movement `state` value returned is context-sensitive and depends on the role of the requesting user. The state may differ depending on whether the viewer is the Originator or the Counterparty of the movement.

parameters.name: movementNumber
parameters.description: Movement number of the movement to retrieve

parameters.name: siteIdentifier
parameters.description: Specifies the site context for the request. The endpoint returns movements where this site is either the departure or arrival location.

put.summary: Updates an existing movement record (sync or async).
put.description: Updates the details of an existing movement identified by the given movementNumber. The request body should contain the updated movement data. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the movement is updated immediately and the updated resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the update status. If the specified movement does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: movementNumber
parameters.description: movement number of the movement to update

delete.summary: Deletes an existing movement record (synchronous or asynchronous).
delete.description: Deletes an existing movement identified by the given movementNumber. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In synchronous mode, the movement is deleted immediately and a confirmation is returned in the response. In asynchronous mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the deletion status. If the specified movement does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: movementNumber
parameters.description: The movement number of the movement to cancel.

204.description: No Content. The movement was successfully cancelled.

post.summary: Creates a confirmation for a specific movement (sync or async).
post.description: Creates a confirmation for the movement identified by the given movementNumber. The request body should include the confirmation details. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In synchronous mode, the confirmation is processed immediately and the resulting resource is returned in the response. In asynchronous mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the confirmation status. If the specified movement does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: movementNumber
parameters.description: movement number of the movement to confirm

get.description: The endpoint allows searching and retrieving a list of hauliers.

Retrieves the list of valid rejection reasons that can be applied to movements. The response returns the configured rejection reason codes and their descriptions to support validation and client-side selection when rejecting a movement.

post.description: Creates a new animal in the system using the details provided in the request body. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the animal is created immediately and the created resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the creation status.

get.description: Retrieves one or more animals from the system based on the supplied query parameters. The response returns matching animal summary records that meet the provided filtering criteria. If no filters are supplied, the endpoint returns animals according to the default retrieval rules.

parameters.name: species
parameters.description: The end-point returns animals of this species.

parameters.name: siteIdentifier
parameters.description: The end-point returns animals for this site.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific animal by identifier.
get.description: Retrieves the details of a single animal using its unique identifier. If the specified animal exists, the full resource is returned. If the animal does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The identifier of the animal to get.

put.summary: Updates an existing animal record (sync or async).
put.description: Updates the details of an existing animal identified by the given identifier. The request body should contain the updated animal data. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the animal is updated immediately and the updated resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the update status. If the specified animal does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The identifier of the animal to update.

delete.summary: Deletes an existing animal record (sync or async).
delete.description: Deletes an existing animal identified by the given identifier. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the animal is deleted immediately and a confirmation is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the deletion status. If the specified animal does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The identifier of the animal to delete.

204.description: No Content. The request has succeeded.

get.description: Retrieves one or more lost and found records from the system based on the supplied query parameters. The response returns matching records that meet the filtering criteria. If no filters are provided, the endpoint returns records according to the default retrieval rules.

parameters.name: siteIdentifier
parameters.description: If populated the end-point will return animals for this site.

post.summary: Creates a new lost and found record (sync or async).
post.description: Creates a new lost and found record in the system using the details provided in the request body. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the record is created immediately and the newly created resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the creation status.

get.summary: Retrieves a specific lost and found record by ID.
get.description: Retrieves the details of a single lost and found record using its unique identifier. If the specified record exists, the full resource is returned. If the record does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

put.summary: Updates an existing lost and found record (sync or async).
put.description: Updates the details of an existing lost and found record identified by the given ID. The request body should contain the updated record data. The response behaviour depends on the requested processing mode. In sync mode, the record is updated immediately and the updated resource is returned in the response. In async mode, the request is accepted for processing and a tracking reference is returned to allow the client to monitor the update status. If the specified record does not exist, an appropriate error response is returned.

ApiSubscriptionKey.name: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
ApiSubscriptionKey.description: Your API key. Pass it in the `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header. This is used to identify your application.

ApiAccessToken.description: Use your JWT access token to authorize requests. Pass it in the `Authorization` header. The token is acquired via user authorization flow

datetime.description: A date and time, in the RFC 3339 format (aka ISO8601).

date.description: A date without a time component, in the RFC 3339 format (aka ISO8601).

time.description: A time (no date component), in the RFC 3339 format (aka ISO8601).

allOf.description: This refers to the type of site activity, such as Market, Abattoir, etc.

type.description: This refers to the type of site identifier, such as holdingNumber, fsaNumber, etc.

message.example: The movement state could not be determined at this time. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It should not change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

Errors.description: An array of error details to accompany a problem details response.

allOf.description: This refers to the type of site activity, such as Market, Abattoir, etc.

type.description: This refers to the type of site identifier, such as holdingNumber, fsaNumber, etc.

allOf.description: The departure details - location, date and time for the movement. This is a required field for creating a movement record, representing the origin site where the animal is being moved from.
The arrival location, date and time for the movement. This is a required field for creating a movement record, representing the destination site where the animal is being moved to.

number.description: A unique number for the movement. This field serves as the primary key for tracking individual movements, ensuring each movement record can be uniquely referenced within the system.

allOf.description: A list of movement numbers that are potential matches based on similar departure and arrival sites, dates, and animals. These movements are identified by the system as potential duplicates, but have not yet been verified as matches. This helps track possible inconsistencies that may require further review or validation.

A list of batches, each representing a group of animals of a specific species, specified at the time of creating the movement record. Each batch contains animals identified by their unique `AnimalIdentifiers`, which uniquely track individual animals within the batch.

return.description: If the movement is of 'roaming' kind, this field contains the details of the return movement. When fetching the movement details, it will include information about the return movement such as the movement number, date, and time. This helps track the return journey of the animals after roaming or temporary relocation.

countryCode.title: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Country code
countryCode.description: A valid 2-digit ISO country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), or, an array of valid ISO codes.

matchedMovementNumbers.description: A list of movement numbers that the system has automatically matched based on matching departure and arrival sites, dates, and animals. If multiple movements are found that meet these criteria, the system designates one as the main movement and returns the other matching movement numbers in this array. This ensures accurate tracking and resolution of potential duplicates.

movementKind.description: The type of movement for the livestock, automatically set by the system based on the nature of the movement record. This could include values such as "departure", "arrival", "transfer", or other movement classifications, helping to categorize and differentiate between various types of livestock movements.

inBusinessMoveFlag.description: Indicates whether the movement is an in-business move (same keeper at departure and arrival).

allOf.description: The current status or state of the movement, set by the system. This field tracks the progress or stage of the movementand helps monitor the status of movement throughout the movement review process.

analysisSamples.example: Fecal samples show no sign of parasites

fileName.description: The name of the document being uploaded.

documentContent.description: The binary content of the document to be uploaded (max 5MB).

haulierState.description: The state of a person or organisation.

correspondenceAddress.description: The contact address of a person or organisation.

singleLineAddress.example: The Livery Yard, Hunshelf Bank, Stocksbridge

animal.description: A record of attributes identifying an animal

embryoTransferFlag.description: Indicates if the animal was born via embryo transfer

allOf.description: The animal giving birth to the animal in question. If the animal is a surrogate mother, there will be a genetic dam.
The animal giving birth to the animal in question. If the animal is a surrogate mother, there will be a genetic dam.
The genetic dam if different from the birth dam.
